notes.title: Jwing Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]New Game Mode[/b]
Clear from and above the line to advance to the next level. A new jwing adventure. 

[b]Original Game Mode[/b]
Drop weighted coloured balls onto scales, matching three or more balls horizontally in order to score points. But be careful, as the scales adjust to the weight on them, they can tip changing the field to your advantage, detriment or worse - a game over : when the piles of balls become too high they collapse, ending the game.
[previewyoutube=9t4S3BFt-wI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Saviour Ball Released!
notes.content:
Our new feature - the Saviour Ball - has been added to jwing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35068535/b2e2182dcc1868687b10fee05a82d425ae6005d3.jpg[/img]

The Saviour Ball can be called in either level 16, 17, 18 or 19 to save you - clearing your screen of all balls and allowing you to pursue your highest level and high score.
